title: pm-eng-1on1-prep-olivia-park
content:
Context:
- Weekly 1:1 with Eng Lead (Daniel). Focus: quick status on API perf fixes, Console rollout plan for per-route dashboards, Dedicated capacity alpha feedback, and Private deployment customer blocker (KMS integration).
- Goal: surface risks that need product prioritization, agree on cross-team owners for late-stage fixes, confirm small-scope immediate wins we can ship this sprint.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick wins / metrics (5m)
   - API latency P50/P95 last 7d (region us-west): P50 38ms (-8ms), P95 210ms (-12ms) — source: infra metrics.
   - Error rate: tokenization edge-case spike on 2026-02-20 (root cause: model tokenizer mismatch in v2-runtime).
2) Console rollout (8m)
   - Per-route dashboards beta: what remains to flip to opt-in for internal customers?
   - Rollback plan and telemetry gating (need SLOs + rollout monitors).
3) Dedicated alpha feedback (7m)
   - Customer A: throughput variability during autoscale; possible hot-shard issue.
   - Action: diagnostics snapshot capture + suggestion for autoscale tuning defaults.
4) Private deployment blocker (6m)
   - Customer B failing KMS/HSM authorizations in air-gapped deploy (audit logs not emitted).
   - Ask infra eng: short-term workaround vs long-term fix.
5) AOB / action review (4m)

Notes / Talking points to hit:
- API perf: call out that overall medians are improving but tail still matters for PLG flows. Ask Daniel for prioritization on two small infra fixes that reduce P95: 1) tokenization sync (low risk) 2) batching backpressure threshold tweak (more invasive).
- Console: emphasize that sales wants per-route cost breakdown visible in Console demo next week. Need ETA for enabling per-route cost column + one-click download for finance. Also confirm who owns the rollout post-flag (prod-ops vs console team).
- Dedicated: ask for temporary knob to limit burst size for customers in alpha to reduce hot-shard impact. Determine whether this is config-only or requires runtime change.
- Private/KMS: this is highest priority for the customer (enterprise legal hold). If fix > 2w, discuss compensation + communication plan.

Open questions I want answers to in the 1:1:
- Can we commit to tokenization sync fix this sprint? If not, what's the blocker?
- Who will own the rollout monitors for per-route dashboards? (Expected: console team + SRE alerting)
- For Dedicated autoscale: is the recommendation config change or code change?
- Private KMS: do we have a mitigation we can ship within 5 business days?

Draft messaging for stakeholders (to refine in meeting):
- Engineering -> Sales: "Per-route cost metrics will be available in Console beta by 2026-03-10; we will provide a short walkthrough and a CSV export for finance analysis."
- Eng -> Customer B: "We’re investigating the KMS auth failures; we have a short-term manual workaround and will update you by EOD on the next business day."

Action items (to capture during/after meeting):
action_items: Olivia: Confirm tokenization sync priority with Daniel and add to sprint board — due 2026-03-04
Daniel: Provide ETA for batching backpressure fix (impact analysis + PR plan) — due 2026-03-06
Console Team (Samir): Outline steps to enable per-route cost column + export and owner for monitors — due 2026-03-05
Infra (Alicia): Capture diagnostic snapshots from Dedicated alpha runs and share findings — due 2026-03-07
Private Deployments (Daniel + Infra): Propose short-term KMS workaround + comms for Customer B — due 2026-03-03
